reviews.title: Great CPU
reviews.comment: I got this at a good price - so at the time this was just a no brainier.  I don't think I would buy it at these new prices when there's other choices out there.  However, it is still a great processor for what it is.  I wanted something economical for gaming and that's what I got.  It beats my i5-12400F and i5-13400F so I'm good with that.
reviews.author: Riseabove

reviews.title: Functional
reviews.comment: Good for it's class of CPU, for daily driver desktop use it's perfect
